$comment: The 1378 start scenario (X-25), being built (milestone 10, step 5). Not bundled yet: the game still starts from scenarios/1444 until the switch-over (step 7). Each region's data lives in regions/<key>/ with the same file names and shapes as the 1444 folder; packages/rules/test/scenario-1378.test.ts reads and checks them together. The world/ folder (the generated map) comes when the regions are joined and tools/mapgen is run for this scenario.
name: Autumn 1378

eras.$comment: Era I is stretched back to the start (X-25), so the start falls in Era I as in 1444.

files.regions/<key>/map-nations.json: the region's map nations with their capitals (SETUP-040)
files.regions/<key>/map-owners.json: owner rules handing the region's provinces to map nations, first match wins (SETUP-041); scoped by country, so the regions' order does not matter
files.regions/<key>/rulers.json: each map realm's ruler on the start day (REALM-233)
files.regions/<key>/culture-start.json: court tongues, province tongues and faiths on the start day (CULT-094)
files.regions/<key>/relations.json: relations and facts between realms on the start day (DIPL-020, SETUP-022)
files.regions/<key>/subjects.json: subject records and stances on the start day (SUBJ)
files.regions/<key>/sleeping-realms.json: realms not yet born on the start day, asleep until they form (X-24, X-25)
files.regions/<key>/README.md: what the region covers, its sources and confidence
